note:
MEASURED by LIVE-REVIEW lane session_01AFoLuMb8WEET4qAxe1a7oA, row LR-20261105T1228Z-pkg-3245fc73e2f64536 (commit 992fcdb7), flag_mechanics, route operator_ask. Facts:
- the package's own SL is 2408.177 and its TP 2614.92;
- the bybit_1 resting ETH orders are SL 2384.63 / 2367.11 and TP 2509.58 / 2677.03;
- 2384.63 / 2509.58 belong to sibling e4_oi_shock_1h; the ltr-wake read venue_sl_diverges with a gap of 23.547 > 0.25 x ATR.
The three prop accounts read 0 open positions. bybit_1 is netting one ETH position across 3 packages (trend_donchian_eth_prop, trend_donchian_eth, e4_oi_shock_1h), so a package-level bracket may not exist per package.
TASK:
- Establish whether this is (a) netting by design with the package bracket kept only in the journal (then the packet's mechanics check must read netted positions correctly), or (b) a lost bracket on a live position (then fix it in the order path; a Tier 3 merge).
- Prime Directive: every position keeps both brackets.
Re-entry test: the next ltr packet for an ETH bybit_1 package reads mechanics match, or names netting explicitly. Next: the venue_sl_diverges trigger must skip closed packages and attribute netted stops to their owning package. No review dispatched. THIRD mechanics false wake, NEW CAUSE 2026-11-05T16:32Z: pkg-f76bb92289d143e5 (bybit_1 trend_donchian_sol_4h short). The 16:27Z live review recommended tighten_sl 98.84 -> 94.50; the VM paper auto-apply moved the VENUE stop to 94.5, but the PACKAGE record still reads sl 98.8364, so the wake poster raised `venue_sl_diverges` (gap 4.34 > 0.25 x ATR). After an applied tighten, the package/exit_plan stop is not written back, so EVERY applied tighten produces a false mechanics wake (and the next packet prices options against a stale stop: "stop_level_not_below_price" unpriced 7/7). Fix: the apply path writes the new stop to the package / exit_plan_state (or the divergence check reads the latest applied stop from applied.jsonl). Related: the closed-package false wakes noted above. No review dispatched. LANE 2026-11-06 (session_01AFoLuLYo6WYTVhu2mjZW8M) ROOT CAUSE (MEASURED, trader journalctl 08:01:44-47Z): the two 'unnamed' package-stop moves (ADA pkg-78342b61 0.18747143->0.18664643; SOL pkg-81365629 92.71714->90.87214) were BOTH the structure_exit verdict (reason swing_ratchet, swing_high 0.1858 / 90.54, bar 07:00Z) via order_monitor._apply_update -> modify_open_order -> db.update_order_package; the trader log named it, the package row did not. Not a live-review/desk apply. DEFECT 1: no package sl write recorded its mover. DEFECT 2 (race): the package stop moved 08:01:45Z and a venue read just after showed the OLD stop; the snapshot's ref_sl already equalled the NEW package sl, so the 'package moved since the venue read' guard could not see it -> venue_sl_diverges false wake. FIX (PR pending, Tier 2, hold): src/runtime/sl_mover.py stamps meta.last_sl_move + capped meta.sl_moves {ts,from,to,source,detail} on every package sl write (order_monitor modify path, live_review_apply package_sl_moved, amend_position_sl); live_review_due.venue_events treats a venue read within venue_sl_settle_seconds (150, config/live_trade_review.yaml) of the stamped last move as could_not_look. Packages that moved before deploy have no stamp (no settle window). NOT VERIFIED: the stale venue value 0.1875 at 08:02Z is from the handoff note, not re-measured (the snapshot table keeps only the latest read). Re-entry test: the next structure/trail/apply move on a bybit_1 package shows meta.last_sl_move with its source and no venue_sl_diverges wake inside 150 s of it.
